parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain why Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) is used to carry out the evaluation of expressions.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Identify, with reasons, a data structure that could be used to evaluate an expression in RPN.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Write the infix expression in RPN.

`(a − b) × (a + c) / 7`

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Write the RPN expression as an infix expression.

`a b / 4 * a b + −`

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Evaluate the RPN expression:

`a b + c d /`

where `a = 17`, `b = 3`, `c = 48` and `d = 12`.

Show your working.
